text:
Marta: Heads-up — DHL flagged a hold on the EU lease-return for 20 H100s. Missing return labels on the pallet, hold reason 'documentation'. This is the batch we planned to top off eu-west-1 pool next week.
Adrian: Ugh. ETA on release? We were expecting these for next Monday canary run.
Marta: DHL portal shows 'awaiting shipper confirmation', no ETA. AWB: 348-999-112233.
Kai: If these are stuck >72h we'll need to bump traffic to spare capacity in us-west. Cost delta estimated ~+$3k/day for cross-region egress before we get dedicated capacity up.
Lena: Can NovaSupply confirm if they created the return label? @NovaSupply any paperwork missing on your side? :thinking_face:
NovaSupply: Hi all — checking now. We generated standard RMA docs but carrier says HS code mismatch for items labelled 'compute modules'. Sending corrected manifest in 15m. Sorry for the noise.
Adrian: OK please attach corrected manifest here. Also: are these lease returns or vendor buybacks? Need clarity for customs in EU.
NovaSupply: They're lease returns via our partner GateLease; vendor provided the initial AWB but GateLease must sign the commercial invoice. We missed HS 8473.30.
Marta: Great, that explains it. Two asks: 1) expedite corrected docs to DHL so they release pallet; 2) we need partial replacements ASAP if customs delays >48h — can NovaSupply provide 6 loaner H100s from EU pool?
NovaSupply: We can provide up to 4 immediate loaners from our Amsterdam availability, 2 more within 48h. There will be an express fee — estimate €1,200 per unit (one-time) + shipping.
Kai: Tagging cost: if we accept loaners for 2 days that's ~€9.6k, still cheaper than cross-region traffic and added latency. But we need serials and firmware parity to avoid eviction during deployment.
Lena: Also confirm warranty/insurance for loaners during custody. OpsBot, any auto-approval flow for temporary loaners under €15k?
OpsBot: @Lena — Temporary procurement approvals required for >€5k. Submit PO request with vendor quote doc; expedite flag possible for EU incidents.
Adrian: OK I'll draft PO if NovaSupply confirms final quote and serials.
Marta: NovaSupply — while you push manifest, please also respond on RMA flow: If DHL marks any unit DOA on arrival how do returns/replacements work? We need S/N reconciliation and RMA SLA.
NovaSupply: Standard: report DOA within 5 business days, we handle DOA RMA with next-available replacement. For lease returns, GateLease handles physical return logistics; NovaSupply coordinates replacement provisioning. SLA for replacement depends on stock — express replacements 24–48h if loaners requested.
Kai: Two operational constraints: 1) we need list of serial numbers (incoming) to pre-seed our inventory system to avoid double-allocation; 2) we must ensure KV cache warmers won't fail if node IDs shift. Plan: we'll reserve compute labels for the expected serials, but if loaners arrive with different serials we'll tag them under temp-pool.
Lena: Also customs value: declare as 'leased equipment — no commercial value' to avoid VAT charges — does GateLease sign that?
NovaSupply: GateLease typically uses 'temporary admission' but requires paperwork. We'll attach GateLease declaration form in next message.
Marta: Thanks. If docs are sent within 30m, DHL often turns around same-day. If not, we trigger the loaner PO. Adrian, Kai — can you confirm how many nodes you want right away?
Adrian: Start with 4 loaners; reserve 2 additional as hot spares (total 6) if NovaSupply can deliver within 48h.
Kai: Agreed. Please ensure loaners are pre-quantized image build or we lose time. Add note: kgp-2026-quant image.
NovaSupply: Noted — we'll ship with blank images but can pre-stage `kgp-2026-quant` for express units if requested. Need written confirmation in PO.
Lena: I'll queue an expedited PO; include express fee line and per-unit loaner insurance option. OpsBot — please temp-exempt standard 7-day lead for vendor quotes.
OpsBot: Temporary exemption recorded for this thread, approver: @Adrian. Deadline: 2 business days.
Adrian: Approved. Marta, once we have corrected manifest and GateLease form, I'll sign PO.
Marta: Copy — NovaSupply, please post corrected manifest and GateLease declaration here when ready. If shipping changes (air vs road), flag customs tariff impact.
NovaSupply: Uploading corrected manifest and GateLease declaration now.
NovaSupply: ```
CORRECTED MANIFEST
AWB: 348-999-112233
Items: 20x H100 (compute modules)
HS: 8473.30
Value: 0 EUR (leased equipment)
GateLease reference: GL-77881
```
Marta: Manifest received. DHL updated status to 'release scheduled' — ETA window 24h.
Adrian: Thanks. PO on standby. If any DOA shows up on intake run we need immediate serial reconciliation and express RMA. Document the intake test plan here: steps to run smoke + KV sanity check.
Kai: Intake test plan (short): 1) power & NVSM check 2) firmware match 3) run 2-min kv-warmup 4) run perf smoke (p95 latency) 5) tag S/N pass/fail. Post results in /ops/hardware/incoming.
Marta: Perfect. Closing loop: if DHL holds again we execute loaner PO. Otherwise we expect full arrival and intake in 36–48h. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
